comment: Protected check paths (C-97, SPEC-20261119-check-guard). check-guard reads this file from the BASE branch only, so a pull request is always judged by the list it started from. Matching: an entry containing * is a whole-path glob, an entry ending with /** is a path prefix, every other entry is an exact path. A PR changing any entry must declare audit-tier: 2 in its body. The merge gate must judge every entry tier 2 as well (gate::TIER2_PREFIXES in src/gate.rs); tests/protected_paths_one_list.rs fails when an entry is added here without it.
